items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the equivalence of four conditions on an algebraic space: being Zariski locally quasi-separated over the base, being Zariski locally quasi-separated, and the existence of Zariski covers by pieces admitting quasi-compact surjective etale maps from affine schemes, with or without the requirement that those affines map into affine opens of the base (statement lines 1064-1081). The proof (proof lines 1083-1149) refines one kind of cover into the other, deduces quasi-separatedness over the base from the quasi-compactness of the diagonal tested on the cover, and runs the implication backwards using the existence lemma for such covers. H2: a cycle of implications with three inputs, written out in full.
